name: jekyll-obsidian
description: Frontend assets and browser checks for the configurable Jekyll Obsidian template.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:prepared
scripts.test:prepared: npm run typecheck && vitest run && node --test tests/node/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:browser-sites: for theme in minimal docs; do GITHUB_REPOSITORY=example/jekyll-obsidian JEKYLL_ENV=production bin/build --example --theme "$theme" --url http://127.0.0.1:4173 --baseurl "/__site__/$theme" --destination "_site-browser-$theme" --skip-assets || exit; done; GITHUB_REPOSITORY=example/jekyll-obsidian JEKYLL_ENV=production bin/build --url http://127.0.0.1:4173 --baseurl /__site__/docs-i18n --destination _site-browser-docs-i18n --skip-assets
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:prepared
